scope: Punch-event detection trained and evaluated on YOLO + RTMW-m 2D pose extracted from every BoxingWeb train/test MP4. GT pose is used only for oracle red/blue association during this diagnostic experiment.

data.interpolation: linear across missing and skipped frames

selection_policy: Architecture, feature mode, ensemble weights, threshold, and NMS were selected on the final 4 training matches. Test labels were not used for the final ensemble setting.
decision: Use the three-model RTMW-adapted ensemble. Frame-derived 3D remains excluded because it sharply degraded event detection.
limitations: Red/blue identity association still uses GT pose and must be replaced by UVE for production.
RTMW is evaluated every third video frame; full-rate inference may recover some short punches at higher compute cost.
The remaining F1 gap to GT pose is 0.0396, concentrated in a few difficult camera/viewpoint matches.
